translation.text: The South Water elevator will be closed to all passengers during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren Station for elevator access. For the latest service alerts and real-time info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.
SWS - Worth Station Parking Lot Resurfacing

Beginning Tuesday, September 1, through Wednesday, September 16, portions of the Worth station parking lot will be closed off for resurfacing. Please allow extra travel time arriving to the station during this period and see posted signage for direction.
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are now open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.

The Bensenville station is currently undergoing construction for a roof replacement. The station remains accessible and customers are advised to use caution passing through the work area during this time.
Milwaukee District North Ongoing Major Track Project Affecting Midday Service Sept. 9 - Oct 23

September 9 - October 23, ongoing track work to replace 4.5 miles of rail will affect midday service between Fox Lake and Round Lake. Passengers boarding at these stations should utilize alternate Metra lines or other transportation. Visit metra.com for more info.
MED Van Buren Street Ticket Vending Machines Out Of Service Until September 13, 2026

Van Buren Street Station ticket vending machines will be out of service until September 13, 2026, due to communication system updates. Passengers are encouraged to use the Ventra App to purchase tickets during this time.
MDN Forest Glen Station Construction Beginning Monday, August 31

Beginning Monday, August 31, a portion of platform 2 including the stairway located on Elston Ave will be closed due to scheduled station construction. Customers should use the tunnel and stairs located on Forest Glen Ave to access platform 2.

Platform construction will take place at the Morton Grove station beginning Monday, August 3 through Spring 2027. Please allow additional travel time and use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.
